description: The project's series: each with its kind (video, pictures or newsletter), where its episodes come from (a season Marsell plans, or the day's news on a topic), how often it comes out, whether it is running and the owner's standing yes, its narrator's voice, what comes next (for a news series: the newest day's story, or why there was none) and, for a video series, what it costs a month against the plan (every_scheduled_type: all its video types on the schedule together, when there is more than one; series_video_types_read gives each type's choices). Also the accounts the business has that a series can post to (known_accounts, for series_start). Marsell can run a series in the owner's own voice, made and posted every day from the day's news on a topic (for example daily archaeology news): each day it searches the news on the topic, drops what the series already reported, picks the best new story and makes a cited Short about it, narrated in a voice the project kept (the owner's own clone: voice_clone); a day with no new story gets no episode. Reading spends nothing.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
